import MumfordLib.SingularCohomologyPuncturedSphere
import Mathlib.Topology.Connected.TotallyDisconnected

/-!
# The intersection of the standard circle charts

The circle minus two antipodal points is homeomorphic to the punctured real
line. Radial contraction retracts this line onto its two unit points, so its
positive-degree integral singular cohomology vanishes. This is the intersection
calculation for the circle cover used in Mumford, Chapter I, Section 1, p. 3.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open CategoryTheory Opposite
open scoped Simplicial

namespace Mumford.Analytic

private theorem singularSimplex_eq_constant_of_discrete {X : TopCat}
    [DiscreteTopology X] {n : ℕ} (σ : (TopCat.toSSet.obj X).obj (op ⦋n⦌)) :
    σ = constantSingularSimplex n
      ((X.toSSetObjEquiv (op ⦋n⦌) σ) (stdSimplex.vertex 0)) := by
  apply (X.toSSetObjEquiv (op ⦋n⦌)).injective
  ext t
  exact isPreconnected_univ.constant
    (X.toSSetObjEquiv (op ⦋n⦌) σ).continuous.continuousOn
    (Set.mem_univ t) (Set.mem_univ _)

/-- Every positive-degree cocycle on a discrete space has a primitive. -/
theorem singularCocycle_exists_primitive_of_discrete {X : TopCat}
    [DiscreteTopology X] {n : ℕ} (φ : singularCocycles X (n + 1)) :
    ∃ ψ : IntegralSingularCochain X n,
      singularCoboundaryToCocycles X n ψ = φ := by
  let ψ : IntegralSingularCochain X n := singularCochainOfSimplexFunction
    (fun σ => (singularSimplexChain (constantSingularSimplex (n + 1)
      ((X.toSSetObjEquiv (op ⦋n⦌) σ) (stdSimplex.vertex 0))) ≫ φ.1).hom 1)
  refine ⟨ψ, Subtype.ext ?_⟩
  change singularCochainCoboundary ψ = φ.1
  apply integralSingularCochain_ext
  intro τ
  rw [singularSimplex_eq_constant_of_discrete τ]
  generalize (X.toSSetObjEquiv (op ⦋n + 1⦌) τ) (stdSimplex.vertex 0) = x
  have hφ : singularCochainCoboundary φ.1 = 0 := φ.2
  have h := singularCochainCoboundary_eval φ.1 (constantSingularSimplex (n + 2) x)
  rw [hφ] at h
  simp only [Limits.comp_zero, ModuleCat.hom_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply,
    constantSingularSimplex_face] at h
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ] at h
  simp only [Fin.val_zero, pow_zero, one_mul, Fin.val_succ, pow_succ,
    mul_neg_one, neg_mul, Finset.sum_neg_distrib] at h
  rw [singularCochainCoboundary_eval]
  simp only [constantSingularSimplex_face]
  have heval : (singularSimplexChain (constantSingularSimplex n x) ≫ ψ).hom 1 =
      (singularSimplexChain (constantSingularSimplex (n + 1) x) ≫ φ.1).hom 1 := by
    dsimp only [ψ]
    rw [singularCochainOfSimplexFunction_eval]
    rfl
  simp only [heval]
  linarith

/-- Positive-degree integral singular cohomology of a discrete space vanishes. -/
theorem integralSingularCohomology_eq_zero_of_discrete {X : TopCat}
    [DiscreteTopology X] {n : ℕ}
    (c : IntegralSingularCohomology X (n + 1)) : c = 0 := by
  obtain ⟨φ, rfl⟩ := singularPositiveCohomologyClass_surjective X n c
  exact (singularPositiveCohomologyClass_eq_zero_iff X n φ).mpr
    (singularCocycle_exists_primitive_of_discrete φ)

/-- Radial normalization on a punctured real normed vector space is a homotopy
equivalence with its unit sphere. -/
def puncturedNormedSpaceHomotopyEquivSphere {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [NormedSpace ℝ E] : ContinuousMap.HomotopyEquiv
      {x : E // x ≠ 0} (Metric.sphere (0 : E) 1) := by
  let r : C({x : E // x ≠ 0}, Metric.sphere (0 : E) 1) :=
    ⟨fun x => ⟨‖(x : E)‖⁻¹ • (x : E), by
      simp [norm_smul, x.property]⟩,
      Continuous.subtype_mk
        (((continuous_subtype_val.norm.inv₀ (fun x => norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr x.property)).smul
          continuous_subtype_val)) _⟩
  let i : C(Metric.sphere (0 : E) 1, {x : E // x ≠ 0}) :=
    ⟨fun x => ⟨x, ne_zero_of_mem_unit_sphere x⟩,
      continuous_subtype_val.subtype_mk _⟩
  refine ⟨r, i, ⟨{
    toFun := fun p =>
      ⟨((1 - (p.1 : ℝ)) * ‖(p.2 : E)‖⁻¹ + (p.1 : ℝ)) • (p.2 : E), ?_⟩
    continuous_toFun := ?_
    map_zero_left := ?_
    map_one_left := ?_ }⟩, ?_⟩
  · apply smul_ne_zero _ p.2.property
    apply ne_of_gt
    have ht : 0 ≤ (p.1 : ℝ) ∧ (p.1 : ℝ) ≤ 1 := p.1.property
    have hx : 0 < ‖(p.2 : E)‖⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr (norm_pos_iff.mpr p.2.property)
    by_cases h : (p.1 : ℝ) = 1
    · simp [h]
    · exact add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg
        (mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr (lt_of_le_of_ne ht.2 h)) hx) ht.1
  · apply Continuous.subtype_mk
    exact (((continuous_const.sub (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_fst)).mul
      ((continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_snd).norm.inv₀
        (fun p => norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr p.2.property))).add
      (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_fst)).smul
        (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_snd)
  · intro x
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp [r, i]
  · intro x
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp
  · have h : r.comp i = ContinuousMap.id _ := by
      ext x
      change ‖(x : E)‖⁻¹ • (x : E) = x
      simp [norm_eq_of_mem_sphere x]
    rw [h]

/-- The punctured real line has zero positive-degree integral singular cohomology. -/
theorem integralSingularCohomology_puncturedReal_eq_zero {n : ℕ}
    (c : IntegralSingularCohomology (TopCat.of {x : ℝ // x ≠ 0}) (n + 1)) : c = 0 := by
  have hs : (Metric.sphere (0 : ℝ) 1).Finite := by
    rw [Real.sphere_eq_pair 0 zero_le_one]
    simp
  letI := hs.to_subtype
  let e := singularCohomologyHomotopyEquiv (X := TopCat.of {x : ℝ // x ≠ 0})
    (Y := TopCat.of (Metric.sphere (0 : ℝ) 1))
    puncturedNormedSpaceHomotopyEquivSphere (n + 1)
  obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := e.surjective c
  rw [integralSingularCohomology_eq_zero_of_discrete d, map_zero]

private def puncturedCircleHomeomorphReal (v : Circle) :
    ({v}ᶜ : Set Circle) ≃ₜ ℝ := by
  letI : Fact (Module.finrank ℝ ℂ = 1 + 1) := ⟨Complex.finrank_real_complex⟩
  exact ((stereographic (norm_eq_of_mem_sphere v)).toHomeomorphSourceTarget.trans
    (Homeomorph.Set.univ _)).trans
      ((OrthonormalBasis.fromOrthogonalSpanSingleton 1
          (ne_zero_of_mem_unit_sphere v)).repr.toHomeomorph.trans
        ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (ι := Fin 1) (𝕜 := ℝ)).toHomeomorph.trans
          (Homeomorph.piUnique (fun _ : Fin 1 => ℝ))))

private theorem puncturedCircleHomeomorphReal_neg (v : Circle) :
    puncturedCircleHomeomorphReal v
      ⟨-v, by simpa using Circle.neg_ne_self v⟩ = 0 := by
  letI : Fact (Module.finrank ℝ ℂ = 1 + 1) := ⟨Complex.finrank_real_complex⟩
  have hs : stereographic (norm_eq_of_mem_sphere v) (-v : Circle) = 0 := by
    convert! stereographic_apply_neg v using 1
  change (Homeomorph.piUnique (fun _ : Fin 1 => ℝ))
    ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (ι := Fin 1) (𝕜 := ℝ))
      ((OrthonormalBasis.fromOrthogonalSpanSingleton 1
        (ne_zero_of_mem_unit_sphere v)).repr
          (stereographic (norm_eq_of_mem_sphere v) (-v : Circle)))) = 0
  rw [hs, map_zero, map_zero]
  rfl

/-- Stereographic projection restricts to a homeomorphism from the intersection
of the two antipodal charts to the punctured real line. -/
def circleChartIntersectionHomeomorphPuncturedReal (v : Circle) :
    ({v}ᶜ ∩ {-v}ᶜ : Set Circle) ≃ₜ {x : ℝ // x ≠ 0} := by
  let e := puncturedCircleHomeomorphReal v
  let a : ({v}ᶜ : Set Circle) := ⟨-v, by simpa using Circle.neg_ne_self v⟩
  let f : ({v}ᶜ ∩ {-v}ᶜ : Set Circle) ≃ₜ
      {x : ({v}ᶜ : Set Circle) // x ≠ a} :=
    { toFun := fun x => ⟨⟨x, x.property.1⟩, fun h => x.property.2
        (congrArg (fun z : ({v}ᶜ : Set Circle) => z.val) h)⟩
      invFun := fun x => ⟨x.1.1, x.1.2, fun h => x.2 (Subtype.ext h)⟩
      left_inv := fun _ => rfl
      right_inv := fun _ => rfl
      continuous_toFun := (continuous_subtype_val.subtype_mk _).subtype_mk _
      continuous_invFun := (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_subtype_val).subtype_mk _ }
  refine f.trans (e.subtype ?_)
  intro x
  have ha : e a = 0 := puncturedCircleHomeomorphReal_neg v
  rw [← ha, e.injective.ne_iff]

/-- Every positive-degree integral cohomology class on the intersection of the
two antipodal circle charts is zero. -/
theorem integralSingularCohomology_circleChartIntersection_eq_zero (v : Circle) {n : ℕ}
    (c : IntegralSingularCohomology (TopCat.of ({v}ᶜ ∩ {-v}ᶜ : Set Circle)) (n + 1)) :
    c = 0 := by
  let e := singularCohomologyHomotopyEquiv
    (X := TopCat.of ({v}ᶜ ∩ {-v}ᶜ : Set Circle))
    (Y := TopCat.of {x : ℝ // x ≠ 0})
    (circleChartIntersectionHomeomorphPuncturedReal v).toHomotopyEquiv (n + 1)
  obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := e.surjective c
  rw [integralSingularCohomology_puncturedReal_eq_zero d, map_zero]

/-- Every positive-degree integral cocycle on the intersection of the two
antipodal circle charts has a primitive. -/
theorem singularCocycle_circleChartIntersection_exists_primitive (v : Circle) {n : ℕ}
    (φ : singularCocycles (TopCat.of ({v}ᶜ ∩ {-v}ᶜ : Set Circle)) (n + 1)) :
    ∃ ψ : IntegralSingularCochain (TopCat.of ({v}ᶜ ∩ {-v}ᶜ : Set Circle)) n,
      singularCoboundaryToCocycles (TopCat.of ({v}ᶜ ∩ {-v}ᶜ : Set Circle)) n ψ = φ := by
  exact (singularPositiveCohomologyClass_eq_zero_iff _ n φ).mp
    (integralSingularCohomology_circleChartIntersection_eq_zero v
      (singularPositiveCohomologyClass _ n φ))

end Mumford.Analytic
